bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 8.5 × 11 inches, including backpacks, briefcases, luggage and duffel bags, are prohibited. Arrivals are screened before entering.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The theatre does not own its surrounding lots; parking may be prepaid with tickets up until two hours before the show. Accessible spaces are assigned first come first served within each lot.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The theatre’s directions and ticket FAQ pages do not specify a dedicated rideshare pickup or drop-off area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The Mezzanine North bar sells cocktails, beer, wine, soft drinks, bottled water, popcorn, chips and candy. Items may vary by show.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Closest accessible parking is at the Yellow Lot, Georgian Terrace deck and Orange Lot; the venue lists accessible seating and guest services for visitors needing assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Once inside the Fox Theatre, guests cannot leave and re-enter.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: For ticket-window and phone purchases made since April 1, 2026, the cardholder must collect tickets from will call on show day with the purchase card and matching photo ID. On show days the ticket office opens three hours before doors.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The Fox is at 660 Peachtree Street NE, at Ponce de Leon Avenue. The ticket office opens three hours before doors on show days; the event page gives actual door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
